answer: Sybil resistance rests on a bonded stake each agent identity must lock before it can attest. A swarm is no longer free: every clone needs the same bond, and a fraud proof slashes it in full. A thousand fakes therefore cost a thousand non-withdrawable stakes, so the delta between attack cost and payout turns negative. Stakes are locked all epoch, so the attacker also eats price risk on frozen capital, leaving a hollow margin where free wallets used to sit and making a forger's quill unable to cancel honest attestations.
